text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we met the other day. Have you, um,
seen Machan?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Whew... Okay, laps done! Let's get back onto campus, Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Machan? What's up with the white pigeon?
Wait, is it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. You went to sea, Little Floofy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to bid you a proper
farewell?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Machan?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The pigeon was lifeless.
I didn't know what
to do. I looked away for a
second, and the
next thing I knew, she was gone.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's a strange girl, always wandering off
alone. She might have just
gone off to
bury the bird somewhere, but still...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She seems like the type to just
mysteriously disappear someday, so
I'm
kind of worried...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've talked to Aston Machan a couple of
times over the past few days,
but I can't
say I ever felt that from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case,
I'm sure she must be in shock.
I agree to look around for
her and leave
campus.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And... there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find Aston Machan at the same overpass
that she and Little Floofy
had napped
under together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stands up, and in front of her is a
mound of earth that looks
freshly made.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since you're a white pigeon, are white
flowers your favorite? Or
maybe red? I saw
some yellow ones over there too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I should've asked your favorite color at
the
very least. Machan failed
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like she's been crying at
all.
Instead, she's facing the
tiny gravestone
head-on and talking calmly to it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I took lots of photos and
videos of you. I promise I'll
never forget
you, Little Floofy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Your memory's safe and sound with
Machan. You'll soar around the
sky forever
in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? I didn't see you there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm an Umamusume, so I'm more
muscular than humans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She disappeared along with her friend
Little Floofy's lifeless body, so
I thought
she might've been overcome with grief. I
explain that's what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see,
that kind of "strong." I've seen a lot
of people get sad when
others died.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I have a different view. Life always
follows the same flow. That's
what I
learned in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My mother is a doctor, so when I was
growing up, my playground was the
hospital.
The hospital is a place where life
flows.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It flows from upstream to downstream. All
life is born, then it flows,
and inevitably
goes to sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There are no exceptions. Little Floofy,
you, and me—we'll all go to
sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In the same way that we need oxygen to
breathe, the clouds are out
of reach, and
the sun sets in the evening, it's a normal
part of reality.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So that's why it's not sad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at a loss for words. Unaware of my
confusion or simply
unconcerned, she goes
on.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What is sad is being forgotten. It'd be sad if you and I forgot about Little Floofy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So what's most important is the mark you
leave behind. A trace that
lives on even
after you're gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This reminds me of what she said the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: My dream... is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had jumped to the conclusion that her
reason for wanting to be a
mascot was the
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But now I'm convinced that I got it wrong.
The real reason is simple,
humble, yet
gut-wrenching...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did you turn to stone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but want to get to the bottom
of this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, Machan, you see...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan's taking part in the Tracen Meet
tomorrow, and she's going to
be a big
deal, so you should come and watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we look for flowers for the
gravestone together. I've still
yet to hear
her put the answer into words.
